name: native-milestone-saturated

baseline.revisionLabel: Preserved original native tsc-ts; historical build sidecar absent

methodology: Direct original native artifact versus retained Go, after indexed-storage retention decision only. Nine alternating fresh-process pairs TypeORM/tRPC and five VS Code/Sentry, one warmup each, identical GNU time/RSS wrappers, same physical libraries and project settings, default runtime/checker settings; native worker count is not assumed equal to Go. All samples retained. Both ratio of medians and median of paired native/Go ratios reported per workload. No historical speedup multiplication. A finite current-gap measurement, not universal performance or statistical-confidence evidence. Native binary SHA pinned but historical build provenance sidecar absent. No concurrent builds/tests/profiles.
